head_templates.name: de-adj
head_templates.expansion: frei (strong nominative masculine singular freier, comparative freier, superlative am freiesten or am freisten)

etymology_text: From Middle High German vrî, Old High German frî, from Proto-West Germanic *frī. Compare Dutch vrij, English free, Danish fri.

derived.word: For adjectives derived from -frei in the sense of "free of

categories.name: German entries with incorrect language header

glosses: free; unrestricted; more negative also: unrestrained; licentious

examples.text:
Wer schläft und ist von Sorgen freier?
Der Tod belauscht die stille Nacht
So wie des Nilstroms Ungeheuer
